item.title: CenterPoint Energy stages 3,300 workers, equipment in Houston region for expected overnight freeze
item.description: CenterPoint Energy has positioned approximately 3,300 frontline workers, including additional resources brought in from outside the region, at two staging sites in the northern Houston area.

item.title: Multi-alarm fire at Richmond apartments displaces dozens, injures 3
item.description: Three people were taken to the hospital and dozens of residents were displaced after a multi-alarm apartment fire early Saturday morning, according to the Richmond Fire Department.

item.title: National Weather Service Forecast: Next 7 Days
Tesla Megapack Facility Leads Record Year for Waller County Economic Development
item.description: Tesla's 1.2 million-square-foot Megapack manufacturing facility, Grundfos' 150,000-square-foot expansion, and two new TMEIC plants headlined a record-breaking 2025 for the Waller County Economic Development Partnership.

item.title: Aga's Restaurant, Houston's No. 1-Ranked Eatery, Plans Katy Location at Grand Parkway and I-10
item.description: Houston's top-ranked restaurant in 2025, Aga's Restaurant & Catering, is opening its second location in Katy at the Grand Parkway and Interstate 10. The award-winning Pakistani eatery has been recognized by the News York Times.

item.title: Suspect arrested in double homicide of Katy couple on Bent Springs Lane
item.description: KATY, Texas (Covering Katy News) — A man accused of killing a Katy-area couple Jan. 12 in their home has been arrested and charged with capital murder, according to Harris County Sheriff Ed Gonzalez.

item.title: Council approves $4.4 million drainage project for west Katy
item.description: The project involves installing more than one mile of new storm sewer pipe up to 54 inches in diameter, as well as asphalt pavement overlays and concrete street panel replacements. The project also includes realigning Franz Road...

item.title: Mayor Thiele names Dana Massey Interim Fire Chief, First Woman to Lead Department following Chief Parker's planned Feb. 2 retirement
item.description: The Katy City Council Monday approved the appointment of Dana Massey as interim fire chief as current Chief Kenneth Parker plans to retire Feb. 2, 2026.

item.title: Carl Little Named New CEO of Houston Methodist West Hospital in Katy Area
item.description: Carl Little, senior vice president of Houston Methodist and CEO of Houston Methodist Clear Lake Hospital, will become the next CEO of Houston Methodist West Hospital in April.
